About Us

Authentic
Ocean Culture

Bali Surf Line Up is more than a surf school - it's a gateway to Bali's authentic ocean culture. Founded by I Made Martin ("Tempe"), the school offers safe, high-quality, and personalized surf experiences for everyone, from beginners to advanced surfers.

With nearly 20 years of experience in Bali's waves, Coach Tempe combines deep local ocean knowledge with professional coaching certifications (ISA & Balawista) to ensure every student learns with proper technique and top safety standards.

Experience the best surfing in Bali with professional instructors.
